      "name": "kernel",

      "evidence": "Modifies the libbitcoinkernel public C API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and implementation in bitcoinkernel.cpp to provide structured logging entries and decouple kernel logging from logging.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Redesigns the kernel logging interface to deliver structured metadata and separates kernel logging from node-specific logging machinery. As noted in the description, replacing string-based log delivery with structured btck_LogEntry objects resolves an interface limitation where consumers had to parse formatted strings ('cumbersome, brittle, and inefficient'), and removes node logging baggage from the library."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates kernel unit tests and sanitizer suppressions solely to accommodate the kernel logging API changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Changes to test files and suppression lists are secondary adjustments to test the refactored kernel logging interface rather than modifications to shared test framework machinery."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adjusts src/bitcoin-chainstate.cpp mechanically to conform to the updated bitcoinkernel logging API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The change to bitcoin-chainstate.cpp is a routine update to the example tool to match the new kernel API, not a meaningful feature or bugfix for tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",

      "rationale": "The changes decouple kernel logging from node utility logging by introducing a dedicated internal KernelLogger; the focus is entirely on the kernel boundary and API."
    },
